t.E160b.agn: In 2019 EFSA used separate ADIs for the colouring components of annatto: bixin 6 mg/kg and norbixin 0.3 mg/kg body weight. It found no genotoxicity concern; it reported that the norbixin limit may be exceeded in high-consuming young children in one country, and that this is not a health concern.
t.E160b.body: Annatto pigments (bixin and norbixin) pass from the gut into the blood but are cleared quickly from the blood: in volunteers, after a single dose bixin disappeared from the blood within 8 hours, while norbixin decreased more slowly. In rats fed low doses for one year, no accumulation in tissues was seen.
t.E160b.prod: Obtained from the seed coat of the annatto tree by extraction with solvents, alkali or oil.
t.E160b.regx.0: Bixin ADI 6 mg/kg, norbixin 0.3 mg/kg; no health concern.
t.E160b.summary: A yellow-orange colour obtained from the seeds of the annatto tree. Used in cheddar cheese, butter and snacks.
